_comment: iOS 3.1.3 (7E18) overlay on rootfs/recipe.json. Applied by scripts/versions.py into build/fw-3.1.3/recipe.json; the 4.2.1 recipe is never changed. The 3.1 dyld shared cache exists but every 8C148 file patch points at code that moved, so none is applied until it is relocated by symbol (docs/multi-version.md). Our userland binaries are built against 4.2.1's exported symbols and are not installed yet; Cydia/TLSFix packages are 4.2.1-only. The liblockdown body/table below are the 7E18 equivalents of the 8C148 activation patches (symbol-relocated from 4.2.1), so 3.1.3 has offline activation answers without a dyld-cache override. SpringBoard stdout/stderr go to the console for bring-up diagnostics (no 3.x applog tool is installed).
_todo: Relocate 8C148 dyld-cache patches by image symbol for 7E18 (liblockdown activation, MBX2D strings), then build a version-tagged userland subset: 3.x has IOSurface/CoreMotion selectors that moved, but it does have a dyld cache and enable-dylibs-to-override-cache.

extra_file_patches.why: 7E18 liblockdown: relocate 8C148's lockdown_copy_value stub to VA 0x3176a008 (cache offset 0x176a008). Its body is the same except one branch displacement; the verified original bytes are from this cache. The stub looks up the activation key in the table at 0x31767600 and returns the constant value, so SpringBoard can see ActivationState without lockdownd.

7E18 lockdown_copy_value key/value table in a verified zero gap of liblockdown's __TEXT (VA 0x31767600). Eight 7E18 kLockdown*Key variables map to inline __CFString objects (isa ___CFStringClass 0x3852aa08, flags 0x7c8) for Activated/iPod/iPod2,1/3.1.3/7E18/N72AP and kCFBooleanFalse 0x38521ff8. Same layout as the 8C148/8B117 tables.

7E18 liblockdown: lockdown_connect -> nonzero fake handle. With no lockdownd on the 3DS, __local_connect() returns -1 and this function returned NULL, so SpringBoard stopped before calling lockdown_copy_value (GDB breakpoint at the relocated stub never hit). The copy_value table answers all calls through this handle locally.
7E18 lockdown_checkin -> 0 (no lockdownd session to check in with; 8C148 stubs lockdown_activate the same way).
7E18 lockdown_copy_identity -> NULL (iTunes pairing cert/device key: not available offline; 8C148 stubs lockdown_copy_buid_identity the same way).

7E18 lockdown_remove_value -> 0 (no lockdownd). SpringBoard imports it and passes the fake handle from lockdown_connect; without this stub it dereferences an invalid handle and exits during activation. Located by the 8-byte context around 8C148's 0x684bb48 function and verified against this cache.
7E18 lockdown_disconnect -> 0 (SpringBoard calls it on the fake handle; without the stub it faults. 8C148 0x684bbe4, same 8-byte context and original bytes verified).

7E18 -[SBTetherController isTethered] -> NO. The stock method calls IOServiceMatching("AppleTetheredDevice") via _demoCardConnection; on the 3DS there is no such service, and the affirmative branch keeps SpringBoard on the boot LCD path. Returning 0 makes UIKit call +[CAWindowServer server] (GDB: 0 hits before, 3 after) and IOMobileFramebufferOpen. Thumb IMP 0x96761, file offset 0x95760; original prologue push {r4,r5,r6,r7,lr} verified in the extracted executable (re-log 120).

7E18 QuartzCore CA::WindowServer::M2Display::new_server: replace ldr r4,[r5,#0xd0] (display kind from the M2CLCD display) with mov r4,#2, forcing the EAGLServer path. On the 3DS the kind is neither 1 (MBXServer) nor 2 (EAGLServer), so new_server fell through to the plain Server constructor and no render server/display context was created. With this patch GDB hits EAGLServer::EAGLServer (0x31bda5a0) and CAWindowServer::Server::Server (0x31bdf010); verified original bytes at cache VA 0x31bde74c (re-log 120). 4.x caches and overlays are untouched.

7E18 -[SBUIController init] (IMP 0xe141) sends orderFront: to its UIWindow at 0xe344, then sends makeKey: with NO to the status bar window at 0xe374; the main window is never made key, so no CA context/render server starts and the boot spinner stays up (re-log 120). 4.2.1 instead makes the SBUIController window key in init. Repoint the literal pool word at VA 0xe478 (file 0xd478) from the orderFront: selref 0xe9b50 to the makeKeyAndVisible selref 0xebd18, so the existing message send makes the window key+visible. The r2=0 argument that orderFront: used is ignored by makeKeyAndVisible. Verified in QEMU: with this patch the 7E18 CA compositor draws the boot spinner through a real key UIWindow (re-log 121); before it the screen stayed black/spinner with no CA render. Original word 0x000e9b50 verified in the 7E18 executable; no 4.x recipe or shim byte changes.

7E18 -[SBAwayController isLocked] -> NO (Thumb IMP 0x1d47d, file 0x1c47c; original push {r4,lr}/ldr r3 verified). -[SBUIController restoreIconList:] (IMP 0xc975) goes straight to frontLocked:animate:automatically: and returns when the away controller is locked, so the icon list is never restored. With this patch SpringBoard advances from the CA-drawn spinner to the Apple-logo/progress-bar (reset) view (re-log 121 scratch, re-log 122); no restart loop or crash with this patch alone. The companion stubs isDeviceLockedOrBlocked -> NO and isMakingEmergencyCall -> NO were tried and caused 3-5 SpringBoard restarts, so they are NOT shipped.
